---

# C# MSTest

- Use `[TestClass]` and `[TestMethod]`.
- Prefer Arrange / Act / Assert.
- Name tests in English with clear intent.
- Test one behavior per test.
- Verify exceptions with `Assert.ThrowsException<T>()`.
- Keep tests small, readable, and deterministic.
